name: io.github.ecestnrkl/figjam-mcp
description: Query FigJam board context, source-cited answers and snapshot changes through five local MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma token with file_content:read; file_metadata:read also enables cheap freshness checks.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for the configured OpenAI-compatible provider; required for vision and answers.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Explicit OpenAI-compatible provider base URL; .env.example uses OpenRouter.

environmentVariables.name: FIGJAM_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Private local cache root; v4 snapshots are stored in a subdirectory.
